title: Hotaru no Yomeiri: Choitashi

thread.title: Firefly Wedding • Hotaru no Yomeiri - Episode 4 discussion

opinions.point: Viewers strongly enjoyed the central relationship, especially its increasingly affectionate, funny, and emotionally layered dynamic.
Many praised the leads’ characterization and felt the episode showed meaningful emotional development and mutual understanding.
The episode was frequently described as both entertaining and emotionally affecting, balancing comedy with heavier material.
Several commenters liked the firefly imagery and the episode’s visual framing of intimate moments.
The ending theme was considered especially evocative, with some viewers calling it well suited to the show’s melancholy mood.
Some viewers found the apparent path forward suspiciously easy and anticipated complications, while others were simply excited by the romantic direction.
The newly introduced antagonistic group was broadly viewed as annoying, though a few comments expressed hope that at least one new character would prove kind.
